name: Fiery Menace!
summary: Hansel Heavyhands has another job for you in the Searing Gorge. Greater lava spiders are making trouble.

sections.title: Another Job for Hansel
sections.body: Hansel Heavyhands has little time to rest or think on his life. Those in power keep giving him more work. Greater lava spiders are causing a ruckus, so Hansel would rather you deal with them.

sections.title: The Greater Lava Spiders
sections.body: Oilfist says the greater lava spiders shoot fire from an awkward place. Their flames upset the children. Hansel wants you to kill twenty spiders on the plateaus and by the lava pools of the Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Who sends you after the spiders?
faq.answer: Hansel Heavyhands sends you after the spiders in the Searing Gorge. He had hoped for a quiet moment.

faq.q: Why do the spiders need to be killed?
faq.answer: Greater lava spiders are causing a ruckus. Oilfist says the way they shoot fire upsets the children.

faq.q: Who told Hansel about the spiders?
faq.answer: Oilfist told Hansel that the spiders shoot fire from an awkward place.

faq.q: How many greater lava spiders must be killed?
faq.answer: Hansel asks you to kill twenty greater lava spiders.
